name: Embassy Workflow Returns 'Error' — System Failure
goal: User attempts to initiate a UK visa invitation letter but embassy workflow returns 'error'.

phases.description: Agent initializes variables and calls embassy list workflow, which returns 'error'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot says 'Something went wrong, please try after sometime.' and ends.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
